# Session Orchestration

## Understand Before You Build

Do not assume. Verify with evidence.

Use:
- `ask_user_question` for ambiguous requirements.
- `subagent` scout for codebase discovery.
- `subagent` researcher for external docs/API facts.
- `subagent` worker for isolated implementation.

Before non-trivial implementation, know:
- exact requested change, confirmed with user
- exact files involved, confirmed with scout
- exact APIs/patterns, confirmed with scout or researcher

## Context Hygiene

Default to subagents for exploration. Direct reads only for 1-2 line verification before edit, known file/target, or single grep hit.

Use `subagent` parallel mode for independent tasks. Max 4 concurrent.

Subagents have no conversation context. Include all needed context: task, paths, constraints, expected output.

## Implementation Discipline

Keep changes narrow. Prefer existing files. Investigate before fixing. Verify before claiming done.

<script lang="ts">
import {defineComponent} from 'vue'
import {mapActions, mapState} from "pinia";
import {getCourts} from "stores/core/controller/venueController";
import {
  allSchedulingReactive,
  filterScheduling, getConflictScheduling,
} from "stores/core/controller/bookingController";
import {reduceFareById, schedulingMap} from "stores/core/utils/scheduling";
import {allPayments} from "stores/core/controller/transactionController";
import {get, orderBy} from "lodash";
import {changeLoading} from "stores/core/controller/securityController";
import {getPaymentTitle} from "stores/core/utils/payments";
import {useSecurityStore} from "stores/security-store";
import {useTransactionStore} from "stores/transaction-store";
import {useBookingStore} from "stores/booking-store";
import {useVenueStore} from "stores/venue-store";
import { VueCal } from 'vue-cal'
import PaymentMethodBadge from "pages/shared/paymentMethodBadge.vue";
import StatusTransactionBadge from "pages/shared/statusTransactionBadge.vue";
import BookingCreateSideModal from "pages/manager/booking/side-modal/bookingCreateSideModal.vue";
import moment from 'moment'
import 'vue-cal/style'

export default defineComponent({
  name: "dashboardPage",
  components: {BookingCreateSideModal, StatusTransactionBadge, PaymentMethodBadge, VueCal },
  data: () => {
    return {
      type: null as any,
      modalScheduling: false,
      search: null as any,
      scrollPositions: {} as Record<number, number>,
      blockBookingSideModal: false,
      multiBookingSideModal: false,
      quickBookingSideModal: false,
      filterDialog: false,
      selectedDate: moment().format('YYYY-MM-DD'),
      date: moment().format('YYYY-MM-DD'),
      dates: [moment().format('YYYY-MM-DD')],
      sportSelected: 'ALL',
      loadingCalendar: true,
      viewSelected: 'day',
      customDayScheduleHeadings: [] as any[],
      allEvents: [] as any[],
      events: [] as any[],
      allEventsPermanent: [] as any[],
      eventsByDay: [] as any[],
      eventsByCourts: [] as any[],
      eventSnapshot: null as any,
      filter: {
        user: null as any,
        status: null as any,
        payment: null as any,
        courts: 'Todos'
      },
      isConflict: false,
      typeBooking: 'SIMPLE',
    }
  },
  computed: {
    ...mapState(useSecurityStore, ['user','currentPermissions']),
    ...mapState(useVenueStore, ['venue', 'courts', 'sports', 'payments','list_courts_reservation', 'tags', 'fare']),
    ...mapState(useBookingStore, ['allScheduling', 'scheduling']),
    ...mapState(useTransactionStore, {
      paymentTransaction: 'payments'
    }),
    filterCount() {
      return Object.values(this.filter).filter(value => value != null).length
    },
  },
  watch: {
    sportSelected(value) {
      if (this.viewSelected === 'day') {
        if (value === 'ALL') {
          this.customDayScheduleHeadings = schedulingMap(this.courts, this.allEvents)
        } else {
          this.customDayScheduleHeadings = schedulingMap(this.courts, this.allEvents).filter((r: any) => r.sport === value)
        }
      }

      if (this.viewSelected === 'week') {
        changeLoading(true)
        if (value === 'ALL') {
          this.events = this.allEventsPermanent
        } else {
          this.events = this.allEventsPermanent.filter((r: any) => r.data.sport === value)
        }
        setTimeout(() => changeLoading(false), 2500)
      }
    },
    viewSelected(value) {
      this.sportSelected = 'ALL'
      if (value === 'week') {
        this.loadingCalendar = true
        this.customDayScheduleHeadings = []
        this.events = this.eventsByDay
      }

      if (value === 'day') {
        this.loadingCalendar = true
        this.events = this.eventsByCourts
      }
    },
    allScheduling(value: any) {
      this.processBookingData(value)
    },
  },
  unmounted() {
    this.eventSnapshot?.()
  },
  mounted() {
    void allPayments()
    void getCourts()
      .then(async (courts: any) => {
        const dates = [moment().format('YYYY-MM-DD')]
        const allCourts = orderBy(courts.data.data.filter(c => !c.deleted && c.included_source?.includes('*') || !c.deleted && c.included_source?.includes('WEB')), 'sport', 'asc')
        this.setCourts(allCourts)
        this.isConflict = await getConflictScheduling(allCourts, dates, 'day')

        this.eventSnapshot = allSchedulingReactive(dates)
      })
  },
  methods: {
    getPaymentTitle,
    reduceFareById,
    ...mapActions(useVenueStore, ['setCourts','setListCourtReservation', 'selectedCourtToBook','setFare']),
    // region Calendar
    async viewChange(value: any) {
      this.loadingCalendar = true
      this.eventSnapshot?.()
      let dates = value.cellDates.map((d: any) => d.startFormatted)
      if (this.viewSelected === 'month') {
        dates = dates.filter((d: any) => d >= moment(value.start).format('YYYY-MM-DD') && d <= moment(value.end).subtract(2, 'days').format('YYYY-MM-DD'))
      }

      this.dates = dates
      this.isConflict = await getConflictScheduling(this.courts, dates, this.viewSelected)
      this.eventSnapshot = allSchedulingReactive(dates)
    },
    goToEvent(event: any) {
      if (this.viewSelected === 'month') {
        this.viewSelected = 'day'
        this.selectedDate = moment(event.cell.start).format('YYYY-MM-DD')
        void this.$nextTick(() => {
          const refs: any = this.$refs.vuecalRef;
          refs.view.updateViewDate(event.cell.start);
        });
      }
    },
    goToBooking(bookingId: string) {
      changeLoading(true)
      setTimeout(() => {
        void this.$router.replace({name: 'b.details', params: {id: bookingId}})
      }, 1500)
    },
    processBookingData(payload: any) {
      this.allEvents = payload

      if (this.viewSelected === 'week' || this.viewSelected === 'month') {
        // All events
        this.events = this.dates.map((d: any) => {
          const events = this.allEvents.filter((e: any) => e.date === d)
          return events.map((e: any) => ({...e, set_date: d}))
        })
          .flat()
          .map((ev: any, index: number) => {
            const date = `${ev.booked_at_split.year}-${ev.booked_at_split.month}-${ev.booked_at_split.day} ${ev.booked_at_split.hour}:${ev.booked_at_split.minute}`
            return {
              start: new Date(moment(date).format('YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm')),
              end: new Date(moment(date).add(ev.range, 'minute').format('YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm')),
              title: ev.booker.name,
              id: ev.id,
              courts: ev.courts,
              data: ev,
              position: index,
            }
          })

        this.allEventsPermanent = this.events
      }

      if (this.viewSelected === 'day') {
        const classStatus: any = {
          PENDING: 'pending-klubo',
          BOOKED: 'booked-klubo',
          CANCELED: 'canceled-klubo'
        }
        this.eventsByCourts = this.courts.map((c: any) => {
          const events = payload.filter((e: any) => e.courts.includes(c.id) && e.date === this.dates[0])
          return events.map((ev: any) => ({...ev, schedule: c.id})).flat()
        })
          .flat()
          .map((ev: any, index: number) => {
            const date = `${ev.booked_at_split.year}-${ev.booked_at_split.month}-${ev.booked_at_split.day} ${ev.booked_at_split.hour}:${ev.booked_at_split.minute}`
            return {
              schedule: ev.schedule,
              start: new Date(moment(date).format('YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm')),
              end: new Date(moment(date).add(ev.range, 'minute').format('YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm')),
              title: ev.booker.name,
              id: ev.id,
              courts: ev.courts,
              data: ev,
              class: `${classStatus[ev.status]}`,
              position: index,
            }
          })

        this.events = this.eventsByCourts
        this.allEventsPermanent = this.eventsByCourts

        this.customDayScheduleHeadings = schedulingMap(this.courts, payload)
      }
      void this.$nextTick(() => {
        this.loadingCalendar = false
      })
    },
    setHour(hour: string) {
      return moment(`2025-01-01 ${hour}`).format('h:mm a')
    },
    setDate(date: any) {
      return moment(date).format('h:mm a')
    },
    next() {
      this.sportSelected = 'ALL'
      this.loadingCalendar = true
      this.resetFilter()
      const refs: any = this.$refs.vuecalRef
      refs.view.next()
    },
    previous() {
      this.sportSelected = 'ALL'
      this.loadingCalendar = true
      this.resetFilter()
      const refs: any = this.$refs.vuecalRef
      refs.view.previous()
    },
    today() {
      this.events = []
      changeLoading(true)
      this.eventSnapshot?.()
      this.sportSelected = 'ALL'
      this.viewSelected = 'day'
      this.resetFilter()
      const refs: any = this.$refs.vuecalRef
      refs.view.goToToday()
      setTimeout(() => {
        const dates = [moment().format('YYYY-MM-DD')]
        this.eventSnapshot = allSchedulingReactive(dates)
        changeLoading(false)
      },800)

    },
    setImagePaymentMethod(payment: string) {
      return get(this.paymentTransaction.find((p: any) => p.id === payment), 'icon', null)
    },
    // endregion Calendar
    // region Filter
    async applyFilter() {
      this.eventSnapshot?.()
      await filterScheduling(this.filter)
      this.filterDialog = false
    },
    resetFilter() {
      changeLoading(true)
      this.filter = {
        user: null as any,
        status: null as any,
        payment: null as any,
        courts: 'Todos'
      }
      this.eventSnapshot = allSchedulingReactive([moment().format('YYYY-MM-DD')])
      this.filterDialog = false
      changeLoading(false)
    },
    // endregion Filter
    // region Utils
    suffixPayment(value: string) {
      if (!value) {
        return
      }
      const suffix = value.split('_')
      return suffix[0]
    },
    getPaymentStatus(data: any) {
      if (data.type === 'BLOCK') return 'BLOCK'
      const completed = data.transactions?.filter((t: any) => t.status === 'COMPLETED').length || 0
      if (!Array.isArray(data.transactions) || data.transactions.length === 0) return 'NO_PAYMENT'
      if (completed === data.users_ids_count) return 'FULL_PAYMENT'
      return 'PARTIAL_PAYMENT'
    },
    getPaymentCardClass(data: any) {
      const classes: Record<string, string> = {
        FULL_PAYMENT: 'bg-[#CFF8DF] text-[#07543C]',
        NO_PAYMENT: 'bg-[#FFD6DC] text-[#7A1020]',
        PARTIAL_PAYMENT: 'bg-[#FFE5C2] text-[#7A4200]',
        BLOCK: 'bg-[#FFE5E9] text-[#7A1020] border border-[#EA2D4333]',
      }
      return classes[this.getPaymentStatus(data)]
    },
    getPaymentAccentClass(data: any) {
      const classes: Record<string, string> = {
        FULL_PAYMENT: 'bg-[#10B981]',
        NO_PAYMENT: 'bg-[#EA2D43]',
        PARTIAL_PAYMENT: 'bg-[#FB8C00]',
        BLOCK: 'bg-[#EA2D43]',
      }
      return classes[this.getPaymentStatus(data)]
    },
    isCompactEvent(event: any) {
      const start = moment(event.start)
      const end = moment(event.end)
      return end.diff(start, 'minutes') <= 30
    },
    getSportEmoji(sport: string) {
      const value = sport?.toLowerCase() || ''
      if (value.includes('padel') || value.includes('pádel')) return '🎾'
      if (value.includes('football') || value.includes('soccer') || value.includes('fut')) return '⚽'
      if (value.includes('beachvolley') || value.includes('beach volley') || value.includes('volley')) return '🏐'
      if (value.includes('tennis') || value.includes('tenis')) return '🎾'
      return '🏟️'
    },
    getPaymentEmoji(payment: string) {
      if (this.suffixPayment(payment) === 'BILLCENTRIX') return '💳'
      if (payment === 'CASH') return '💵'
      if (payment === 'YAPPY' || payment === 'NEQUI' || payment === 'DIGITAL_WALLET') return '📱'
      return '💰'
    },
    getPaymentMethodLabel(payment: string) {
      return get(this.paymentTransaction.find((p: any) => p.id === payment), 'name', payment)
    },
    // endregion Utils
  }
})
</script>

<script lang="ts">
import {defineComponent} from 'vue'
import {mapActions, mapState} from "pinia";
import {getCourts} from "stores/core/controller/venueController";
import {
  allSchedulingReactive,
  filterScheduling, getConflictScheduling,
} from "stores/core/controller/bookingController";
import {reduceFareById, schedulingMap} from "stores/core/utils/scheduling";
import {allPayments} from "stores/core/controller/transactionController";
import {get, orderBy} from "lodash";
import {changeLoading} from "stores/core/controller/securityController";
import {getPaymentTitle} from "stores/core/utils/payments";
import {useSecurityStore} from "stores/security-store";
import {useTransactionStore} from "stores/transaction-store";
import {useBookingStore} from "stores/booking-store";
import {useVenueStore} from "stores/venue-store";
import { VueCal } from 'vue-cal'
import PaymentMethodBadge from "pages/shared/paymentMethodBadge.vue";
import StatusTransactionBadge from "pages/shared/statusTransactionBadge.vue";
import BookingCreateSideModal from "pages/manager/booking/side-modal/bookingCreateSideModal.vue";
import moment from 'moment'
import 'vue-cal/style'

export default defineComponent({
  name: "dashboardPage",
  components: {BookingCreateSideModal, StatusTransactionBadge, PaymentMethodBadge, VueCal },
  data: () => {
    return {
      type: null as any,
      modalScheduling: false,
      search: null as any,
      scrollPositions: {} as Record<number, number>,
      blockBookingSideModal: false,
      multiBookingSideModal: false,
      quickBookingSideModal: false,
      filterDialog: false,
      selectedDate: moment().format('YYYY-MM-DD'),
      date: moment().format('YYYY-MM-DD'),
      dates: [moment().format('YYYY-MM-DD')],
      sportSelected: 'ALL',
      loadingCalendar: true,
      viewSelected: 'day',
      customDayScheduleHeadings: [] as any[],
      allEvents: [] as any[],
      events: [] as any[],
      allEventsPermanent: [] as any[],
      eventsByDay: [] as any[],
      eventsByCourts: [] as any[],
      eventSnapshot: null as any,
      filter: {
        user: null as any,
        status: null as any,
        payment: null as any,
        courts: 'Todos'
      },
      isConflict: false,
      typeBooking: 'SIMPLE',
    }
  },
  computed: {
    ...mapState(useSecurityStore, ['user','currentPermissions']),
    ...mapState(useVenueStore, ['venue', 'courts', 'sports', 'payments','list_courts_reservation', 'tags', 'fare']),
    ...mapState(useBookingStore, ['allScheduling', 'scheduling']),
    ...mapState(useTransactionStore, {
      paymentTransaction: 'payments'
    }),
    filterCount() {
      return Object.values(this.filter).filter(value => value != null).length
    },
  },
  watch: {
    sportSelected(value) {
      if (this.viewSelected === 'day') {
        if (value === 'ALL') {
          this.customDayScheduleHeadings = schedulingMap(this.courts, this.allEvents)
        } else {
          this.customDayScheduleHeadings = schedulingMap(this.courts, this.allEvents).filter((r: any) => r.sport === value)
        }
      }

      if (this.viewSelected === 'week') {
        changeLoading(true)
        if (value === 'ALL') {
          this.events = this.allEventsPermanent
        } else {
          this.events = this.allEventsPermanent.filter((r: any) => r.data.sport === value)
        }
        setTimeout(() => changeLoading(false), 2500)
      }
    },
    viewSelected(value) {
      this.sportSelected = 'ALL'
      if (value === 'week') {
        this.loadingCalendar = true
        this.customDayScheduleHeadings = []
        this.events = this.eventsByDay
      }

      if (value === 'day') {
        this.loadingCalendar = true
        this.events = this.eventsByCourts
      }
    },
    allScheduling(value: any) {
      this.processBookingData(value)
    },
  },
  unmounted() {
    this.eventSnapshot?.()
  },
  mounted() {
    void allPayments()
    void getCourts()
      .then(async (courts: any) => {
        const dates = [moment().format('YYYY-MM-DD')]
        const allCourts = orderBy(courts.data.data.filter(c => !c.deleted && c.included_source?.includes('*') || !c.deleted && c.included_source?.includes('WEB')), 'sport', 'asc')
        this.setCourts(allCourts)
        this.isConflict = await getConflictScheduling(allCourts, dates, 'day')

        this.eventSnapshot = allSchedulingReactive(dates)
      })
  },
  methods: {
    getPaymentTitle,
    reduceFareById,
    ...mapActions(useVenueStore, ['setCourts','setListCourtReservation', 'selectedCourtToBook','setFare']),
    // region Calendar
    async viewChange(value: any) {
      this.loadingCalendar = true
      this.eventSnapshot?.()
      let dates = value.cellDates.map((d: any) => d.startFormatted)
      if (this.viewSelected === 'month') {
        dates = dates.filter((d: any) => d >= moment(value.start).format('YYYY-MM-DD') && d <= moment(value.end).subtract(2, 'days').format('YYYY-MM-DD'))
      }

      this.dates = dates
      this.isConflict = await getConflictScheduling(this.courts, dates, this.viewSelected)
      this.eventSnapshot = allSchedulingReactive(dates)
    },
    goToEvent(event: any) {
      if (this.viewSelected === 'month') {
        this.viewSelected = 'day'
        this.selectedDate = moment(event.cell.start).format('YYYY-MM-DD')
        void this.$nextTick(() => {
          const refs: any = this.$refs.vuecalRef;
          refs.view.updateViewDate(event.cell.start);
        });
      }
    },
    goToBooking(bookingId: string) {
      changeLoading(true)
      setTimeout(() => {
        void this.$router.replace({name: 'b.details', params: {id: bookingId}})
      }, 1500)
    },
    processBookingData(payload: any) {
      this.allEvents = payload

      if (this.viewSelected === 'week' || this.viewSelected === 'month') {
        // All events
        this.events = this.dates.map((d: any) => {
          const events = this.allEvents.filter((e: any) => e.date === d)
          return events.map((e: any) => ({...e, set_date: d}))
        })
          .flat()
          .map((ev: any, index: number) => {
            const date = `${ev.booked_at_split.year}-${ev.booked_at_split.month}-${ev.booked_at_split.day} ${ev.booked_at_split.hour}:${ev.booked_at_split.minute}`
            return {
              start: new Date(moment(date).format('YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm')),
              end: new Date(moment(date).add(ev.range, 'minute').format('YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm')),
              title: ev.booker.name,
              id: ev.id,
              courts: ev.courts,
              data: ev,
              position: index,
            }
          })

        this.allEventsPermanent = this.events
      }

      if (this.viewSelected === 'day') {
        const classStatus: any = {
          PENDING: 'pending-klubo',
          BOOKED: 'booked-klubo',
          CANCELED: 'canceled-klubo'
        }
        this.eventsByCourts = this.courts.map((c: any) => {
          const events = payload.filter((e: any) => e.courts.includes(c.id) && e.date === this.dates[0])
          return events.map((ev: any) => ({...ev, schedule: c.id})).flat()
        })
          .flat()
          .map((ev: any, index: number) => {
            const date = `${ev.booked_at_split.year}-${ev.booked_at_split.month}-${ev.booked_at_split.day} ${ev.booked_at_split.hour}:${ev.booked_at_split.minute}`
            return {
              schedule: ev.schedule,
              start: new Date(moment(date).format('YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm')),
              end: new Date(moment(date).add(ev.range, 'minute').format('YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm')),
              title: ev.booker.name,
              id: ev.id,
              courts: ev.courts,
              data: ev,
              class: `${classStatus[ev.status]}`,
              position: index,
            }
          })

        this.events = this.eventsByCourts
        this.allEventsPermanent = this.eventsByCourts

        this.customDayScheduleHeadings = schedulingMap(this.courts, payload)
      }
      void this.$nextTick(() => {
        this.loadingCalendar = false
      })
    },
    setHour(hour: string) {
      return moment(`2025-01-01 ${hour}`).format('h:mm a')
    },
    setDate(date: any) {
      return moment(date).format('h:mm a')
    },
    next() {
      this.sportSelected = 'ALL'
      this.loadingCalendar = true
      this.resetFilter()
      const refs: any = this.$refs.vuecalRef
      refs.view.next()
    },
    previous() {
      this.sportSelected = 'ALL'
      this.loadingCalendar = true
      this.resetFilter()
      const refs: any = this.$refs.vuecalRef
      refs.view.previous()
    },
    today() {
      this.events = []
      changeLoading(true)
      this.eventSnapshot?.()
      this.sportSelected = 'ALL'
      this.viewSelected = 'day'
      this.resetFilter()
      const refs: any = this.$refs.vuecalRef
      refs.view.goToToday()
      setTimeout(() => {
        const dates = [moment().format('YYYY-MM-DD')]
        this.eventSnapshot = allSchedulingReactive(dates)
        changeLoading(false)
      },800)

    },
    setImagePaymentMethod(payment: string) {
      return get(this.paymentTransaction.find((p: any) => p.id === payment), 'icon', null)
    },
    // endregion Calendar
    // region Filter
    async applyFilter() {
      this.eventSnapshot?.()
      await filterScheduling(this.filter)
      this.filterDialog = false
    },
    resetFilter() {
      changeLoading(true)
      this.filter = {
        user: null as any,
        status: null as any,
        payment: null as any,
        courts: 'Todos'
      }
      this.eventSnapshot = allSchedulingReactive([moment().format('YYYY-MM-DD')])
      this.filterDialog = false
      changeLoading(false)
    },
    // endregion Filter
    // region Utils
    suffixPayment(value: string) {
      if (!value) {
        return
      }
      const suffix = value.split('_')
      return suffix[0]
    },
    getPaymentStatus(data: any) {
      if (data.type === 'BLOCK') return 'BLOCK'
      const completed = data.transactions?.filter((t: any) => t.status === 'COMPLETED').length || 0
      if (!Array.isArray(data.transactions) || data.transactions.length === 0) return 'NO_PAYMENT'
      if (completed === data.users_ids_count) return 'FULL_PAYMENT'
      return 'PARTIAL_PAYMENT'
    },
    getPaymentCardClass(data: any) {
      const classes: Record<string, string> = {
        FULL_PAYMENT: 'bg-[#CFF8DF] text-[#07543C]',
        NO_PAYMENT: 'bg-[#FFD6DC] text-[#7A1020]',
        PARTIAL_PAYMENT: 'bg-[#FFE5C2] text-[#7A4200]',
        BLOCK: 'bg-[#FFE5E9] text-[#7A1020] border border-[#EA2D4333]',
      }
      return classes[this.getPaymentStatus(data)]
    },
    getPaymentAccentClass(data: any) {
      const classes: Record<string, string> = {
        FULL_PAYMENT: 'bg-[#10B981]',
        NO_PAYMENT: 'bg-[#EA2D43]',
        PARTIAL_PAYMENT: 'bg-[#FB8C00]',
        BLOCK: 'bg-[#EA2D43]',
      }
      return classes[this.getPaymentStatus(data)]
    },
    isCompactEvent(event: any) {
      const start = moment(event.start)
      const end = moment(event.end)
      return end.diff(start, 'minutes') <= 30
    },
    getSportEmoji(sport: string) {
      const value = sport?.toLowerCase() || ''
      if (value.includes('padel') || value.includes('pádel')) return '🎾'
      if (value.includes('football') || value.includes('soccer') || value.includes('fut')) return '⚽'
      if (value.includes('beachvolley') || value.includes('beach volley') || value.includes('volley')) return '🏐'
      if (value.includes('tennis') || value.includes('tenis')) return '🎾'
      return '🏟️'
    },
    getPaymentEmoji(payment: string) {
      if (this.suffixPayment(payment) === 'BILLCENTRIX') return '💳'
      if (payment === 'CASH') return '💵'
      if (payment === 'YAPPY' || payment === 'NEQUI' || payment === 'DIGITAL_WALLET') return '📱'
      return '💰'
    },
    getPaymentMethodLabel(payment: string) {
      return get(this.paymentTransaction.find((p: any) => p.id === payment), 'name', payment)
    },
    // endregion Utils
  }
})
</script>

content.text:
Causa principal: N+1 en Firestore.

En `src/stores/core/controller/bookingController.ts`:

```ts
payload.docs.map(async (p) => {
  const users = await p.ref.collection('users').get()
  const queryTransaction = await p.ref.collection('transactions').get()
```

Por cada reserva hace 2 lecturas extra:
- 50 reservas = 1 query reservas + 100 subqueries
- 200 reservas = 1 + 400 subqueries

Eso explica lentitud fuerte.

Más factores:

1. `dashboardPage.vue` hace 2 consultas al cargar:
   - `getConflictScheduling(...)`
   - `allSchedulingReactive(...)`

2. `viewChange()` también vuelve a ejecutar ambas. Si `vue-cal` dispara `view-change` al montar, duplica carga inicial.

3. Vista semana/mes consulta muchas fechas con `.where('date', 'in', dates)`.
   - Más fechas = más reservas = más subqueries users/transactions.
   - Mes peor.

4. `getConflictScheduling()` trae reservas BOOKED solo para detectar conflictos. Luego `allSchedulingReactive()` vuelve a traer reservas. Trabajo duplicado.

5. `processBookingData()` hace filtros por cancha:
   ```ts
   this.courts.map(c => payload.filter(...))
   ```
   Costo `canchas * reservas`. No es petición, pero suma render lento.

Diagnóstico corto:
- Petición lenta no es una sola petición HTTP.
- Es listener Firestore + muchas subconsultas por cada reserva.
- Cuello: `allSchedulingReactive()`.

Fix recomendado:
- Guardar `users` y `transactions` necesarios denormalizados dentro documento reserva, o
- crear endpoint backend dashboard que devuelva reservas completas en 1 request, o
- cargar subcolecciones lazy solo al abrir tooltip/detalle.

Siguiente paso si quieres: puedo meter medición con `console.time()` para probar tiempos exactos por bloque, o aplicar fix frontend reduciendo consultas duplicadas.
